| 9cc7370eea5bdfcf96e478f0e8bdef10ef036c54661be3b409719f01b91fce0b | `wiki/02_engineering/01_ai_frameworks/04_inductor/scheduler_analysis.md` | 自定义融合 Pass 与排查(合并自 scheduler_fusion_strategies) > A. 历史错误示例（保留用于辨错） | 843 | code_python | 843-884 | import torch<br/>import torch._inductor.config as config<br/>from torch._inductor.graph import GraphLowering<br/><br/>def my_pre_fusion_pass(graph: GraphLowering) -> GraphLowering:<br/>    """<br/>    自定义调度器融合前 Pass<br/>    """<br/>    for node in graph.nodes:<br/>        fx_node = getattr(node, 'node', None)<br/>        if fx_node is None:<br/>            continue<br/><br/>        target = getattr(fx_node, 'target', None)<br/>        if target is None:<br/>            continue<br/><br/>        # 场景 1：防止大输出 Tensor 被融合 (OOM 防护)<br/>        # 检查节点输出大小，超过 64MB 则禁止融合<br/>        if hasattr(node, 'get_outputs'):<br/>            outputs = node.get_outputs()<br/>            if outputs and hasattr(outputs[0], 'numel'):<br/>                # 假设 FP16，64MB ≈ 32M elements<br/>                if outputs[0].numel() > 32 * 1024 * 1024:<br/>                    node.fusable = False  # 关键：关闭融合标记<br/>                    continue<br/><br/>        # 场景 2：强制融合特定模式 (add -> relu)<br/>        if 'aten.add.Tensor' in str(target):<br/>            for user in node.users:<br/>                user_target = getattr(getattr(user, 'node', None), 'target', '')<br/>                if 'aten.relu' in str(user_target):<br/>                    node.fusable = True<br/>                    user.fusable = True<br/>                    break<br/><br/>    return graph<br/><br/># 注册到 Inductor 配置<br/>config.pre_fusion_custom_pass = my_pre_fusion_pass |  | unknown | not_executed | unresolved | [] | unassigned | audit | lines 843-884; balanced=true | False |  |  |

mydevice_inductor/kernel/kernel.py<br/><br/>import sympy<br/>from torch._inductor.codegen.common import Kernel, IndentedBuffer<br/>from torch._inductor.virtualized import V<br/><br/>class MyDeviceKernel(Kernel):<br/>    """<br/>    自定义设备 Kernel 类<br/>    """<br/><br/>    def __init__(<br/>        self,<br/>        scheduler: Optional[Scheduler],<br/>        name: Optional[str] = None,<br/>    ):<br/>        super().__init__()<br/>        self.scheduler = scheduler<br/>        self.name = name or f"mydevice_kernel_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"<br/>        self.code = IndentedBuffer()<br/><br/>    def generate(self) -> str:<br/>        """<br/>        生成完整的 kernel 代码<br/>        """<br/>        # 1. 生成函数定义<br/>        self._codegen_function_def()<br/><br/>        # 2. 生成函数体<br/>        with self.code.indent():<br/>            # 生成索引计算<br/>            self._codegen_indexing()<br/><br/>            # 生成加载操作<br/>            self._codegen_loads()<br/><br/>            # 生成计算操作<br/>            self._codegen_compute()<br/><br/>            # 生成存储操作<br/>            self._codegen_stores()<br/><br/>        return self.code.getvalue()<br/><br/>    def _codegen_function_def(self) -> None:<br/>        """<br/>        生成函数定义<br/>        """<br/>        self.code.writeline("@mydevice.jit")<br/>        self.code.writeline(f"def {self.name}(")<br/><br/>        # 生成参数<br/>        params = self._collect_parameters()<br/>        with self.code.indent():<br/>            for param in params:<br/>                self.code.writeline(f"{param},")<br/><br/>        self.code.writeline("):")<br/><br/>    def _collect_parameters(self) -> List[str]:<br/>        """<br/>        收集 kernel 参数<br/>        """<br/>        params = []<br/><br/>        # 输入指针<br/>        for i, input_tensor in enumerate(self.scheduler.inputs):<br/>            ptr_name = f"ptr_{i}"<br/>            dtype = self._get_dtype_str(input_tensor.dtype)<br/>            params.append(f"{ptr_name}: mydevice.pointer_type({dtype})")<br/><br/>        # 步长参数<br/>        for i, input_tensor in enumerate(self.scheduler.inputs):<br/>            for j, stride in enumerate(input_tensor.stride):<br/>                params.append(f"stride_{i}_{j}: int")<br/><br/>        return params<br/><br/>    def _codegen_indexing(self) -> None:<br/>        """<br/>        生成索引计算<br/>        """<br/>        # 获取 program ID<br/>        self.code.writeline("pid = mydevice.program_id(axis=0)")<br/><br/>        # 计算每个线程的索引<br/>        if len(self.scheduler.output_size) == 1:<br/>            # 1D<br/>            self.code.writeline("idx = pid * BLOCK_SIZE + mydevice.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)")<br/>            self.code.writeline("mask = idx < n0")<br/>        elif len(self.scheduler.output_size) == 2:<br/>            # 2D<br/>            self.code.writeline("pid_m = pid // num_blocks_n")<br/>            self.code.writeline("pid_n = pid % num_blocks_n")<br/>            self.code.writeline("offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + mydevice.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M)")<br/>            self.code.writeline("offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + mydevice.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N)")<br/>            self.code.writeline("idx = offs_m[:, None] * n1 + offs_n[None, :]")<br/>            self.code.writeline("mask = (offs_m[:, None] < n0) & (offs_n[None, :] < n1)")<br/><br/>    def _codegen_loads(self) -> None:<br/>        """<br/>        生成加载操作<br/>        """<br/>        for i, input_tensor in enumerate(self.scheduler.inputs):<br/>            ptr_name = f"ptr_{i}"<br/><br/>            if len(input_tensor.size) == 1:<br/>                # [[correction_report]]?<br/>**TorchInductor 是 `torch.compile` 的默认后端编译器**:把一张已经捕获、已经处理过自动微分的 FX 计算图,**降级(lowering)成基于循环的中间表示,做激进的算子融合(fusion),最后生成 Triton(GPU)或 C++/OpenMP(CPU)kernel 代码**并编译执行。 |  | unknown | not_semantically_audited | unresolved | [] | unassigned | audit |  | False |  |  |

Inductor 是什么,解决什么问题 | 16 | claim_candidate | 16-16 | 它针对的核心矛盾是**内存带宽 vs. 算力**。现代加速器的浮点算力远超访存带宽,深度学习里大量逐元素算子(`add`/`mul`/`sin`/激活/归一化…)本身计算极轻,瓶颈在于反复把张量从显存读进来、算一下、再写回去。Eager 模式下每个算子一个 kernel,中间结果都要落地到全局内存。Inductor 的根本手段就是**把多个算子融合进同一个 kernel**,让中间结果留在寄存器/共享内存里,从而消除冗余的内存往返;再叠加自动调优(autotuning)、内存复用、布局优化等,逼近手写 kernel 的性能,同时完全不需要用户改模型代码。 |  | unknown | not_semantically_audited | unresolved | [] | unassigned | audit |  | False |  |  |
